items.item_text: Develops and implements a strategic donor engagement plan to recognize and retain donors at all giving levels. This includes personalized stewardship for major, endowed, and planned giving donors, ensuring alignment with fundraising priorities and institutional goals.

Oversees impact reporting and donor communications by managing the creation of compelling reports, acknowledgments, and other materials that highlight the impact of philanthropy. Collaborates with university staff and faculty to report on gift usage, ensure compliance with donor intent, track fund utilization, and coordinate with departments to demonstrate impact through reports and personalized outreach. Maintains consistency in messaging and branding while creating meaningful touchpoints that strengthen donor relationships.

Partners with leadership and members of the Philanthropy and Strategic Partnerships team to integrate stewardship into fundraising strategies. Establishes and manages tracking, metrics and reporting processes for stewardship initiatives to assess program effectiveness.
Responds to donor and other external constituent inquiries. Supports university donor related events and activities, which may include nights and weekends.
